name: CARES Act Equity Distribution Model Inputs
attribution: Office of the Chief Financial Officer

Department.Publishing Department: Office of the Chief Financial Officer

columns.name: Geographic ID
columns.description: Place GEOID identifier, as assigned by the US Census Bureau

columns.name: In Cook County
columns.description: Binary indicator of whether municipality is taxed by Cook County (1) or not (0)

columns.name: Population
columns.description: INPUT: 2019 population estimate from Census Population Estimates Program (2019 vintage) https://www.census.gov/data/datasets/time-series/demo/popest/2010s-total-cities-and-towns.html

columns.name: Median Household Income
columns.description: INPUT: Median household income in 2018 dollars, from 2014-2018 5-year ACS (reported in CMAP Community Data Snapshots)

columns.name: Retail Sales
columns.description: INPUT: 2019 total retail sales from IL Dept. of Revenue (reported in CMAP Community Data Snapshots)

columns.name: Total Equalized Assessed Value
columns.description: INPUT: 2018 total equalized assessed value from IL Dept. of Revenue (reported in CMAP Community Data Snapshots)

columns.name: Percent EDA
columns.description: INPUT: Percent of population living in an EDA or disinvested area, calculated from CMAP's 2015 parcel-level population estimates and CMAP's EDA/disinvested layer

columns.name: COVID Deaths
columns.description: INPUT: Total COVID-19 deaths by place of residence as of 6/21/2020, per Cook County Medical Examiner

columns.name: Tax Base
columns.description: DERIVED: Total tax base (i.e. RET_SALES + TOT_EAV)

columns.name: Tax Base Per Capita
columns.description: DERIVED: Tax base per capita (i.e. TAX_BASE / POP)

columns.name: Log of Tax Base Per Capita
columns.description: DERIVED: Natural log of tax base per capita (i.e. LN(TAX_BASE_PER_CAP))

columns.name: Log of Population
columns.description: DERIVED: Natural log of population (i.e. LN(POP))

columns.name: Log of Median Household Income
columns.description: DERIVED: Natural log of median household income (i.e. LN(MED_HH_INC))

columns.name: COVID Death Rate
columns.description: DERIVED: COVID-19 deaths per 100,000 population (i.e. COVID_DEATHS / POP * 100000)

columns.name: Log of COVID Death Rate
columns.description: DERIVED: Natural log of COVID-19 death rate (i.e. LN(COVID_DEATH_RATE+1), where the +1 ensures that a death rate of 0 yields 0 instead of a number error)
